pkgmetadata.longdescription:
libcamera is a complex camera support library for Linux, Android, and ChromeOS. It is designed to support the low-level native camera hardware of embedded platforms (including IPU, CPE, and image sensor devices) and the higher-level system integration needed for complex mobile and IoT devices.
This overlay tracks upstream closely: 0.8.0 "Prague" is the first release containing imx471 sensor support (Sony IMX471, used on ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 14 / Panther Lake IPU7 via the simple pipeline handler and software ISP).
